I've reached it... a new 'phase.' I've 
attained...'luminescence.'

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

I felt everyone's "signal"... A strong 
waveform... A higher-dimensional 
"connect".

too...? At the end of the voyage... if we 
could become a 'binary star.'"

become someone who brings the "tide" to

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

The singularity... I can see it.
I'm going 
to welcome it... How "exciting."

"turbulence." We'll need the strength to 
keep from being swallowed up, won't we?

"neutrinos." Neo Universe takes flight.
